issue.title: Ensure ObjectId is initialized at runtime
issue.body:
This is necessary because the class initializes various fields
based on random values. Furthermore, the values can't easily
be substituted

Fixes: #25476

body:
Thanks
In which version this fix will be available ?

> @zakkak can an entire static init method be substituted in GraalVM?

FTR No, unfortunately there is no way to substitute static init methods...
